title: A surjection from a finite module to a finitely presented module has finite kernel
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $P$ be a finitely generated $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], and let $Q$ be a finitely presented $R$-module [def-sc-finitely-presented-module]. For every surjective $R$-linear map $w:P\twoheadrightarrow Q$, the submodule $\ker w\subseteq P$ is finitely generated.
